name: Tejal Goyal
tagline: Software engineer. I build AI agents, data pipelines, and things that are fun to use.
about: I build AI agents that talk to real systems, data pipelines that hold up, and small things that are fun to use. I’m finishing an M.Eng. in Applied Data Science (December 2026). Off the clock: F1 every race weekend, speedcubing, and a serious banana bread.

portfolio.title: tgoyal.me
portfolio.blurb: My site, set like a newspaper. It reads like one right up until you touch it.

Dime.title: dime
Dime.blurb: An expense tracker you text like a friend. It files everything and has opinions about your spending.

type.blurb: A blank page that exists to be typed on. No timer, no score, just how the keys feel.

bide.blurb: Every bus on a live 3D map, plus a daily scoreboard of whether its arrival predictions were lying.

iam-threat-mapper.title: iam-threat-mapper
iam-threat-mapper.blurb: Five real breaches, taken apart one login at a time and drawn as the attacker’s playbook.

claubi.blurb: A coding agent that doesn’t trust the code it writes, and asks before it acts. Rust, on your machine.

lockin.blurb: A job-hunting intern that never asks for coffee. Scans job lists twice a day and files the best new roles.

wiki.blurb: One deep lesson a day, wired into a growing wiki of software, data and ML.

sudoku-app.title: sudoku
sudoku-app.blurb: Nine boxes, nine digits, zero ads. A calm Sudoku built out of pure spite.

WalletRIP.blurb: The original expense tracker: privacy-first, zero personal data. It grew up into Dime.

SmartHire.blurb: AI resume screening. Matches applicants to job descriptions in under 15 seconds.

threatscope.title: threatscope
threatscope.blurb: A threat-intelligence chatbot you can just ask, backed by MITRE ATT&CK, CVEs and CISA’s exploited list.

OnTop.blurb: A macOS menu bar utility that pins windows above everything.

Nib.blurb: A menu bar scratchpad for macOS.

chibi-design-system.blurb: The design language behind my apps.
